title: Design System: Vincent Lauriat — hub (the flight case)

display.purpose: The case-marking voice: h1, stamps, case/zone stencil marks. Never used for Han glyphs (ZH h1 falls back to the sans stack at 800).

block.purpose: Die-cut sticker lettering and caution-tape values; always uppercase on stickers.

mark.purpose: Hand-lettered sticker voice; also the round GH sticker.

type.purpose: Lede, sticker sublabels, tape labels, the entire manifest, footer plate copy.

shadows.name: sticker-rest
shadows.purpose: Vinyl sitting on laminate; inset line is the vinyl edge catching light.

shadows.name: sticker-lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus peel state, paired with translateY(-5px) scale(1.03) and z-index 55.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Caution-tape band floating off the case.

shadows.name: manifest
shadows.purpose: The taped paper sheet — deepest shadow in the world.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: Riveted footer plate; inset top line is machined edge light.

shadows.name: handle
shadows.purpose: Filter shadow under the recessed-handle SVG.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The peel: sticker corner curl + lift, .22s. The world's only motion grammar.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Manifest row arrow translateX(4px) on hover/focus.

components.name: Die-cut Sticker
components.description: The signature component: a project as die-cut vinyl on the case. Per-sticker inline API: --c color, --x/--y position, --r rotation, --w width, --z chronology; one shape class, one voice class, one age class. Hover peels the corner.
components.html: RTKInfostoken savings
components.css: .ds-stk { position: relative; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 190px; min-height: 44px; padding: 20px 16px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; background: var(--c, #34d399); color: #17130d; border: 5px solid #f0e9d8; border-radius: 18px; transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)); box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12) inset; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .22s ease; } .ds-stk::before { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -5px; top: -5px; width: 34px; height: 34px; background: linear-gradient(225deg, #16130f 0 48%, #d8d0bc 50%, #efe8d6 100%); border-radius: 0 18px 0 14px; box-shadow: -3px 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transform: scale(0); transform-origin: top right; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-stk:hover, .ds-stk:focus-visible { transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)) translateY(-5px) scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.65); } .ds-stk:hover::before, .ds-stk:focus-visible::before { transform: scale(1); } .ds-stk-nm { font-family: 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.05; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stk-sub { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: .62rem; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Language Sticker Toggle
components.description: Language switch as three small vinyl stickers: inactive ones are sun-faded via filter, the active one is a fresh caution-yellow sticker lifted 1px.
components.css: .ds-langtog { display: flex; gap: 9px; } .ds-lang { min-height: 44px; min-width: 46px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .04em; background: #f0e9d8; color: #17130d; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14) inset, 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.55); transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)); filter: saturate(.45) sepia(.28) brightness(.82); transition: filter .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-lang:not(.on):hover { filter: saturate(.8) sepia(.1) brightness(.95); } .ds-lang.on { filter: none; background: #e8b90f; transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)) translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3) inset, 0 4px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.55); }

components.css: .ds-tape { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(0,0,0,.14) 0 3px, transparent 3px 22px), linear-gradient(180deg, #f0c422, #e8b90f 55%, #caa00c); border-top: 3px solid #171410; border-bottom: 3px solid #171410; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.5); clip-path: polygon(0 8%, 1% 0, 99% 3%, 100% 12%, 100% 88%, 99% 100%, 1% 97%, 0 90%); transform: rotate(-1.4deg); } .ds-tape-cell { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 22px; white-space: nowrap; color: #171410; } .ds-tape-v { font-family: 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-tape-k { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3a3008; } .ds-tape-sep { width: 2px; align-self: stretch; background: rgba(23,20,16,.5); }

components.name: Manifest Row
components.description: One line of the typewritten packing manifest: ref / name / description / arrow on a baseline grid; hover is a red stamp-ink wash plus a 4px arrow nudge. The manifest is the catalog and screen-reader backbone.
components.html: B-01MacInsideCPU load, real SMC temperatures, fan RPM — one native dashboard.→
components.css: .ds-manifest { background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 27px, rgba(35,32,26,.05) 27px 28px), linear-gradient(180deg, #f2ebd8, #ece4cf 30%, #e3d9bf); color: #23201a; padding: 24px; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.6); font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-mrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 178px 1fr 34px; gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.5; min-height: 44px; } .ds-mrow:hover, .ds-mrow:focus-visible { background: rgba(200,53,43,.09); } .ds-mrow:hover .ds-marw, .ds-mrow:focus-visible .ds-marw { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-mref { font-weight: 700; color: #5f573f; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-mname { font-weight: 700; } .ds-mdesc { color: #4a4433; } .ds-marw { justify-self: end; transition: transform .2s ease; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Zone Stencil Mark
components.description: Beige spray-stencil label painted on the laminate between sticker clusters. Decorative (aria-hidden); the manifest carries the real structure.
components.css: .ds-zone { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Saira Stencil One', sans-serif; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a2977c; opacity: .85; white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(-2deg); }

components.name: Ghost Residue
components.description: Adhesive residue of a torn-off sticker: die silhouette, translucent vinyl border, grainy radial fill. Non-interactive, aria-hidden, used sparsely.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-block; width: 170px; height: 120px; border-radius: 18px; background: radial-gradient(80% 70% at 40% 45%, rgba(217,207,182,.10), rgba(217,207,182,.05) 70%, transparent); border: 5px solid rgba(240,233,216,.14); transform: rotate(-5deg); opacity: .9; }

narrative.overview: The hub is not a page about a portfolio; it is one physical object — a road case owned by one builder, photographed straight-on. Black scuffed laminate, riveted aluminium extrusion rails and corner braces framing the viewport, and years of die-cut vinyl stickers accreted on the lid: 28 stickers, one per shipped project, each carrying its project's own accent color inside a white vinyl border. Depth is chronology — the newest stickers sit highest in the stack and shine, the oldest have yellowed and bleached. Facts print on a strip of yellow caution tape; findability lives in a typewritten packing manifest taped to the case; the footer is a riveted spec plate. It refuses the dev-portfolio card grid entirely. Every texture is authored in CSS/SVG. Where the world's mess and the catalog's job conflict, clarity wins: sticker names stay legible, and the manifest — not the sticker field — is the screen-reader and findability backbone.
keyCharacteristics: One object, not a layout: fixed aluminium frame, laminate ground, accreted stickers.
Depth = time: z-index and fading (age-0…age-3) encode shipping chronology together.
Four lettering voices (stencil, block, marker, typewriter), zero system display faces.
One motion: the sticker corner peel. Nothing else moves for decoration.
All claims printed on the case are factual and countable.

rules.name: The Sticker-Owns-Its-Color Rule
rules.body: Project accents (--c, set inline per sticker) come from each project's own landing-page identity; the hub palette never dictates them. Ink on a sticker is always dark (--sink defaults to --ink); never white text on an accent.

rules.name: The One Loud Voice Rule
rules.body: Caution yellow is the only saturated color the case itself speaks. Everything else on the laminate is beige, alu, or near-black.

rules.name: The Paper World Rule
rules.body: Red exists only on paper (manifest); paper colors never leak onto the laminate, and laminate beige never appears on paper.

rules.name: The Four Voices Rule
rules.body: Every piece of text speaks in exactly one of the four voices; the voice varies per sticker but never mixes inside one sticker name.

rules.name: The ZH Exception Rule
rules.body: Chinese never uses the stencil face; it takes --font-sans at 800 (hub override) plus base.css's ZH sizing/line-breaking floor. Nothing may degrade in FR or ZH.

rules.name: The Chronology-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: Stacking is meaning: --z rises with recency (lead sticker --z:40, freshest 30–39, oldest 5–9) and always pairs with the matching age-* class. A new sticker goes on top; never re-sort the pile alphabetically or by grid.

rules.name: The Recompaction Rule
rules.body: Below 761px the accretion flows but stays an accretion: rotations and die-cut shapes survive; only the coordinates die.

rules.name: The One Peel Rule
rules.body: The world has exactly one motion idea: the peel. Corner curl + lift on hover/focus-visible, ease-out-quint cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) at .22s; secondary state transitions stay under .25s. No entrance animations, no parallax, no loops.

rules.name: The Never-Square Rule
rules.body: Anything stuck onto the case carries both a rotation and a die-cut radius. Only the case's own machined parts (rails, braces, separators) may be perfectly straight.

dos: Do add a new project as sticker + manifest row together, and bump the tape counts, the zone counts, --field-h, and the meta/og descriptions in the same change.
Do put a new sticker on top: age-0, filter: none, a --z above the current maximum, positioned in its zone's cluster; demote the previous .lead if the newcomer is the flagship.
Do give every sticker one shape class, one voice class, one age class, a project --c with dark ink, a 40px stroke icon, and the 5px vinyl border.
Do keep all texture authored in CSS/SVG (--grain, scratch gradients, inline SVG) — zero external images.
Do keep every visible string trilingual (.en/.fr/.zh spans) and every control at ≥44px — the base.css floor is binding and WCAG AA may not regress.
donts: Don't reflow the field into a uniform grid, equalize sticker sizes, or zero the rotations — the irregular accretion is the identity; clarity is won by legible names and the manifest, not by tidying the pile.
Don't add a second motion idea. The peel (ease-out-quint, ≤.25s) is the entire grammar; no entrance animations, parallax, marquees, or hover glows.
Don't write light text on an accent or on yellow — ink on stickers and tape is always dark (--ink / --on-accent: #17130d).
Don't let paper and laminate worlds bleed: no red on the case, no stencil-beige text on the manifest, no cool base.css surface colors (#0a0c12 family) anywhere on this page.
Don't print a claim the corpus can't count — facts on tape, stamp, and plate stay factual ("21 instruments", "0 telemetry", "signed & notarized"; apps are EN/FR only — never promise ZH for the apps).
